props.doc: Whether the backdrop is forced to render even when nested.
props.name: forceRender

drawer.Backdrop.summary: An overlay displayed beneath the popup.

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
props.name: nativeButton

drawer.Close.summary: A button that closes the drawer.

drawer.Content.summary: A container for the drawer contents.

drawer.Description.summary: A paragraph with additional information about the drawer.

drawer.Indent.summary: A wrapper element intended to contain your app's main UI.

drawer.IndentBackground.summary: An element placed before `<Drawer.Indent>` to render a background layer that can be styled based on whether any drawer is open.

drawer.Popup.summary: A container for the drawer contents.

props.doc: Whether to keep the portal mounted in the DOM while the popup is hidden.
props.name: keepMounted

drawer.Portal.summary: A portal element that moves the popup to a different part of the DOM.

drawer.Provider.summary: Provides a shared context for coordinating global Drawer UI, such as indent/background effects based on whether any Drawer is open.

props.doc: Whether the drawer is initially open. To render a controlled drawer, use the `open` prop instead.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.doc: Whether the drawer is currently open.
props.name: open

props.doc: Event handler called when the drawer is opened or closed.
props.name: onOpenChange

props.doc: Snap points used to position the drawer. Use numbers between 0 and 1 to represent fractions of the viewport height, numbers greater than 1 as pixel values, or strings in `px`/`rem` units (for example, `'148px'` or `'30rem'`).
props.name: snapPoints

props.doc: Whether to prevent the drawer from closing on outside presses. For non-modal drawers, this also prevents the drawer from closing when focus moves outside of it.
props.name: disablePointerDismissal

props.doc: A handle to associate the drawer with a trigger. If specified, allows detached triggers to control the drawer's open state. Can be created with the Drawer.createHandle() method.
props.name: handle

props.doc: Event handler called after any animations complete when the drawer is opened or closed.
props.name: onOpenChangeComplete

props.doc: Disables velocity-based snap skipping so drag distance determines the next snap point.
props.name: snapToSequentialPoints

props.doc: The swipe direction used to dismiss the drawer.
props.name: swipeDirection

drawer.Root.summary: Groups all parts of the drawer.

props.doc: The swipe direction that opens the drawer. Defaults to the opposite of `Drawer.Root` `swipeDirection`.
props.name: swipeDirection

props.doc: Whether the swipe area is disabled.
props.name: disabled

drawer.SwipeArea.summary: An invisible area that listens for swipe gestures to open the drawer.

drawer.Title.summary: A heading that labels the drawer.

props.doc: A handle to associate the trigger with a drawer. Can be created with the Drawer.createHandle() method.
props.name: handle

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
props.name: nativeButton

props.doc: A payload to pass to the drawer when it is opened.
props.name: payload

props.doc: ID of the trigger. In addition to being forwarded to the rendered element, it is also used to specify the active trigger for drawers in controlled mode (with the Drawer.Root `triggerId` prop).
props.name: id

drawer.Trigger.summary: A button that opens the drawer.

drawer.Viewport.summary: A positioning container for the drawer popup that can be made scrollable.

drawer.VirtualKeyboardProvider.summary: Provides keyboard-aware focus and scroll handling for bottom-sheet drawers with form fields.
